parties.petitioner: Chief Revenue Controlling Officer Cum Inspector General of Registration & Ors.

summary: Stamp valuation dispute; Form I notice validity; mandatory reasons for undervaluation; Section 47-A(1) Stamp Act compliance; spot inspection/local enquiry sufficiency; natural justice violation; High Court quashed valuation orders; appeal challenges procedural defects in referral process; standard: reason recording essential for referral.
final_judgment: Leave granted; appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; valuation orders restored.
